title: Three learning layers - outcomes flow down, provider truth flows up

children.title: Layer 1 - Model Bandit (per platform:model)
lines: Beta posterior over success/failure · decayed exponentially, 2-day half-life (lazy, on touch)
cold-start probe until 5 samples · 10% explore least-sampled · exploit: 0.7 × bandit + 0.3 × user preference

children.title: Layer 2 - Key Pool (per key)
lines: EMA reliability + speed posteriors · model-scope whitelists · cooldown state
cost-scaled cooldowns: free 5s · <$0.5 30s · <$3 60s · pricey 5min · 402 → 24h bench (only extends)
free-first failover: paid keys route last · provider-informed benches survive success

children.title: Layer 3 - Quota Truth (per provider)
lines: x-ratelimit-* / Retry-After parsed per vendor: NVIDIA swapped order · Cerebras -day/-minute namespaces · Anthropic family
confidence model: header 1.0 > error body 0.75 > probe 0.6 - most trustworthy source per (platform, key, pool, metric)
pool inference: groq::account · openrouter::free · google::project - two keys, one account = one budget

children.text: jimesh open-source AI gateway · every proxied call teaches both upper layers

connect.label: RouteEvent → ApplyFeedback (Redis Stream jimesh:events · inline fallback) · 4xx filtered out
429/402 → cost-aware cooldown · 200 with remaining=0 → precise bench (no failure stat)
